page.content:
Cave-temples and manuscript hoard at Dunhuang.

How Mogao Caves connects

  • Location: Dunhuang — The Mogao Caves are cut into the cliffs at Dunhuang.
  • Work: Dunhuang manuscripts — The sealed library was hidden in a Mogao cave.
  • Event: Buddhism transmission — The Mogao Caves are a monumental archive of transmitted Buddhism.

What is Mogao Caves?

The Mogao Caves preserve wall-paintings and the sealed library that documents Buddhism's travel, Sogdian letters, and the everyday paper of the eastern Silk Road.

Key threads lead to Dunhuang, Dunhuang manuscripts and Buddhism transmission.
